body: Commit e291f16, pushed to origin/main as 0d6aecc..e291f16. Both were client-side display bugs (my_owner used instead of team; absolute instead of viewer-relative node color) -- sim-side win/capture logic was already correct on audit. Verified live with a real 20-player match, human client deliberately connected as owner 19 (team 1) to reproduce the exact broken scenario -- screenshot confirms YOU WIN now displays correctly. Full suite unaffected (461 checks).
title: Fixed two real team-mode bugs: YOU WIN/LOSE showed the wrong result for most players, and captured nodes rendered in the wrong (enemy-looking) color
